study_card.main_practice: 跟读 + 精读 + 中文讲解对照
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 再听读 · 最后完成英文输出

segments.en: My program stops with an error. The message says that a key is missing. I read the last line first. It tells me where the program stopped. Then I look at the data and find a different spelling.
segments.tts: My program stops with an error. The message says that a key is missing. I read the last line first. It tells me where the program stopped. Then I look at the data and find a different spelling.
segments.zh: 我的程序因为错误停止了。错误信息说一个 key（键）缺失。我先读最后一行，它告诉我程序停在哪里。然后我查看数据，发现拼写不一样。讲解：error message=错误信息，missing=缺失的，spelling=拼写。

segments.en: I fix the spelling and run the program again. This time, another error appears. Debugging is not one big jump. It is a series of small checks. I fix one problem, run again, and learn from the next message.
segments.tts: I fix the spelling and run the program again. This time, another error appears. Debugging is not one big jump. It is a series of small checks. I fix one problem, run again, and learn from the next message.
segments.zh: 我修正拼写，再次运行程序。这次出现了另一个错误。debugging（调试）不是一次大跳跃，而是一连串小检查。我修一个问题，再运行，再从下一条信息中学习。讲解：debug=调试，series=一连串，appear=出现。

segments.en: At the end, the program runs. I write down what happened. The note will help me next time. I am not afraid of errors now. An error is a message that can guide me.
segments.tts: At the end, the program runs. I write down what happened. The note will help me next time. I am not afraid of errors now. An error is a message that can guide me.
segments.zh: 最后程序运行了。我记下发生了什么，这条笔记下次会帮助我。现在我不再害怕错误。错误是一条可以指导我的信息。讲解：write down=记下，guide=指导，at the end=最后。

chunks.eg: Fix the code and run again.
Debugging is a series of small checks.

patterns.t: I am not afraid of X.

transfer_tasks.task: Write a short team message about fixing an error. Use the last line, run again, and write down.
